description: Custom shopping cart domain services for managing order discounts and customer pricing.

elements.name: orders:applyDiscount
description: Applies customer-specific discounts to order totals based on customer type (VIP, PREFERRED, or EMPLOYEE).

input_parameters.name: customerType
description: The classification of the customer determining the discount rate to apply. Valid values include VIP (20% discount), PREFERRED (10% discount), or EMPLOYEE (7% discount).

input_parameters.name: orderTotal
description: The original total amount of the order before any discounts are applied.

output_parameters.name: orderTotalAfterDiscount
description: The final order total after the appropriate customer discount has been subtracted from the original order total.
